work.title: TEAR Figure
work.description: Street mural on a weathered blue wall depicting a stylized figure rendered in dense black-and-white horizontal stripes, with a fragmented hatched face showing pink lips and heavy-lidded eyes. Cascading black rectangular tags bearing the word 'TEAR' descend along the left side; small looping chain motifs appear at the shoulders.
work.composition: central tall paste-up on blue wall
